title: On Receipt
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 94): the 19 reports that an event sets off in eleven public instruments on advanced AI, read from the receiver's side. One row each, grouped by who receives it, on a figure with a door drawn down the middle: left of it the sender's deadline to scale, as the text counts it; right of it six marks for what the receiver must, may or is only encouraged to do once the word arrives (reply, review, order a stop, pass it on, tell the public, a periodic total), each with its deadline; then what the text says follows for a silent sender and for a silent receiver. Each row opens to the passages its codes rest on, with references, notes and doubts. Drawn by script with no library; every quote checked word for word against the texts as fetched on 2026-11-25 (check_quotes94.py), every figure read from the page and recounted by verify94.mjs at 1100 and 390 pixels. State 2 (study 95, 2026-11-26): the record of the two cases of step 6 read for what each receiver did. One timeline per case, May to November 2026, one row per receiver: the day the word arrived, each act lettered by what it did (reply, investigate or ask, stop, pass on, tell the public, a reason not to, court) and drawn by what owed it (a duty, a power or a general law, nothing), with the deadlines receivers set and the case's first public account. Each row opens to its passages; every passage checked word for word against the sources as fetched on 2026-11-26 (check_quotes95.py), every figure recounted from cases95.json by verify95.mjs.
embodies: Of the 19 reports an event sets off, 11 go to a public body. Only 2 of those bodies must do anything with a developer's report, and what they must do is review it (California's Office of Emergency Services, New York's office in the Department of Financial Services); 3 more may review or evaluate. None must reply to the sender (0), none must order a stop (the EU Commission may, 1), none must tell the public of a single report (0); 5 must produce a yearly anonymised total, sent to legislators and the governor, the first due in 2027 (California) and 2028 (New York). No public body's duty or power carries a clock (0), and no text names a consequence for a public body that does nothing (0); 3 bodies are named as receivers with no task at all. On the sender's side every law that obliges a report names a fine (5 of 5): up to 3 % of worldwide turnover or EUR 15 million in the EU, up to $1 million in California and up to $1 million then $3 million in New York, in both states naming a large frontier developer while the duty to report lies on every frontier developer. The only receivers bound by a clock or a court are the maker's own record: under the EU Code of Practice a signatory must pass a third party's word on a serious incident to the AI Office within 2 to 15 days of knowing, and under California's law a large developer owes an employee who reports through its internal process a monthly update, with a court's award of fees as the remedy. Predictions P158, P159 and P160 all failed, each on the maker's own record, and all three hold for the public bodies. Part B, the Atelier's handoff: the 75 deeds recounted from Git carry the same author names in 75 of 75 (61 the architect's alone); none of the 75 says in its commit message that a machine session made it, although the same reader finds 8 session links and 21 co-author lines elsewhere in the site's history, and 39 of the 61 carry a pull-request number, so what could name the session stands on the forge, outside Git. State 2: in the two cases the public record shows the word reaching 18 doors (a receiver in one case), 17 of which left 47 acts. 37 were owed by nothing; a duty owed 4, 3 of them in doubt, the undoubted one the maker's quarterly report to California's Office of Emergency Services of 26 September, which says the models involved fall outside the report's scope. Every public body was first seen acting only after the case's first public account (reports to them are confidential, so the record cannot show a body acting unseen) (the first 3 days after in the wiki case, 7 in the escape); California's office said the escape did not meet its threshold, and the FBI, told by 16 July, shows no act. Of 12 acts of force by public bodies and legislatures, 2 used a power an AI instrument gives (the Commission's requests for information); 2 subpoenas, a lawsuit and all 3 deadlines set on the maker came from state attorneys general and members of Congress acting outside the AI instruments. No sanction, binding order or formal finding by 2026-11-26. Predictions P161, P162 and P163 held.
